4066520.title: Trust Your Gut
4066520.short_description: A multi-ball roulette roguelite. Spin multiple balls at once and rewrite the wheel: add colors, change the numbers, rebalance payouts and stack multipliers with 100+ mementos and 50 trick balls. You’re live on a twisted TV show, and the puppet Host is grinning. Hit his targets, or the show ends you.

2781660.title: Dawn of Defense
2781660.short_description: Dawn of Defense blends RTS, Tower Defense, and Roguelite progression. In a last defense, lead your tribe against the Empire: Command warriors in battle, fortify defenses, and build an economy as you fight to reclaim your ancestral homeland.

5200620.title: Dungeonbound
5200620.short_description: A roguelike autobattler where you manage your inventory, forge items together and craft the craziest build you can while battling the builds of other players.

5189160.title: We March as One
5189160.short_description: Start with a few shapes and build an army tens of thousands strong. Paint your troops onto the battlefield and send them to war against enormous hordes in this incremental auto battler where every unit is individually simulated.

4459590.title: Slotbound
4459590.short_description: A roguelike auto-battler defense where luck meets strategy. Spin a 3x3 slot machine to summon units and grow your army by absorbing others. Use Items and Cores to manipulate the odds and survive challenging judgement waves and boss waves. Every spin and every choice counts.

2784470.title: 9 Kings
2784470.short_description: A fast-paced roguelike kingdom builder. Grow your empire and fight massive battles against powerful rival kings. Break the game with thousands of insane builds to become the King of Kings.

4739500.title: JOHN GLEEP
4739500.short_description: JOHN GLEEP is a tiny alien with a big problem. His casino is a failure and he owes the mob a galaxy. Solution? Fly from planet to planet and forcibly abduct gamblers to boost business, pay off your debt, and fix your failed marriage in this unexplainable intergalactic action-roguelike mashup.

2638080.title: Annihilated
2638080.short_description: A story-driven roguelite RPG about a journey through the depths with a broken hero — and what they have to answer for. The hero's party has been annihilated: you carry one of them out of a cursed dungeon, learn what broke them, and settle it together. Four routes, four heroes, four reckonings.

1211600.title: ZED ZONE
1211600.short_description: A great catastrophe has struck. While on a mission, your aircraft crashes and you are trapped in the Zed Zone. Zombies and monsters are everywhere. To escape, gather materials, upgrade your skills, build shelters, and defeat zombie hordes and mysterious mechs as you chase a glimmer of hope.

4358660.title: Hull Rupture
4358660.short_description: If the ship stops, humanity ends. Manage a spaceship, treat puny humans as resources, and repel relentless alien assaults in a base-management tower-defense roguelite where every choice seemed reasonable at the time.

4984400.title: Towers of Babble
4984400.short_description: Word Game Tower Defense. Spell AXE to harvest wood. Spell FORT to make an armored tower. Every word you spell becomes a tower with unique stats and powers. Every word is also a unique level with procedural challenges. 121,683 levels. Together we must clear them all to reach paradise.
